headnotes.text: Once the state pleads abuse of the writ, a habeas petitioner must show that failing to raise a claim in an earlier petition was not intentional withholding or inexcusable neglect. Omitting a widely recognized, foreseeable claim, despite experienced counsel and a court order to raise all grounds, bars the claim in a successive petition.
